scope: Initial shared source particle presentation and display shaders only. Superseded by v1.1: whole-source audit found six mixed-axis splash descriptors unsupported by v1; see fidelity-fx-backend-v1-1-headless.json. Native replay numerical code and source assets unchanged. No GPU validation or full suite.

red.reason: Actual missing source samplers, independent depth order, expiry clearing, public duration and game muzzle streak

renderProfiles.native: Recovered packed RGBA, UV, original blend flags, seed and original source keys remain numerical source data; native D3D pixel equivalence is unclaimed.
renderProfiles.game_cannon: Original eleven-layer smoke plus two short axial streak quads using original fx_streakin_001 DDS, warm game tint and finite 0.14 second injected-clock lifetime; original SSpray INITIAL displays additive warm light in this game profile.
renderProfiles.game_smoke: Original source particles with explicit grey/opacity and soft-depth display treatment, without added muzzle streak.

sorting: One source quad/authored mesh per spatial instance, actual centroid transforms, local camera depth order, uniform priority 4. Engine sorting across effects remains to be verified in GPU captures.
expiry: get_playback_duration queries original configured replay clip. Overrun seeks clip end, clears all draw instances and returns false/expired instead of reusing the preceding frame.
sampler: Initial v1 supports native CC/WW hardware samplers and untouched UV. Subsequent whole-source audit found six clamp mode 2 splash descriptors that v1 incorrectly rejects; v1.1 consumer RED and fix records this omission explicitly.
